comment: Chibi poses Mea can show, matched against the RAW text of her own last reply (all <think> blocks + the final completion — never chat history, never the user's message; see cores/guide/avatar.js's noteReply()). 'angry' and 'happy' are RESERVED: whenever a pose here matches, worker health (ME's own sidecars, not generation success/failure) still overrides it — down -> chibi-angry.png, just-recovered -> chibi-happy.png. Do not add entries with those ids; they are never matched by keyword. Add real poses below as { "id": "<name>", "keywords": ["word", "phrase"] } (case-insensitive substring match, first match in list order wins) or { "id": "<name>", "pattern": "regex source" } for finer control. Each id must have a matching file at assets/guide-avatars/chibi-<id>.png (flat file, no subfolder). Empty by default — in the NORMAL look chibi never activates until poses are added here. The owner can switch the main look to CHIBI with the button in the window header: then a chibi picture is always shown, and the 'default' field is its base pose (chibi-<default>.png) when no pose matches and ME is healthy.
